status_meaning: tested on two sanitized live 3813.7 runs (junie-1, junie-2); every route is experimental (no field-disposition catalog or oracle profile yet)

sources.establishes: the session id that identifies the session directory, the project directory, the lifecycle and the main agent's usage per model
structured steps (view-files, tool and terminal blocks with step ids, status, command, output and exit code), per-call usage, the final answer and the task's named USD total
the run's session id, step summaries without ids, the final answer and the per-model usage with call counts under the result's errorCode member
the CLI's version line (Junie 26.10.20 (3813.7)), retained as text

joins.basis: one session per execution: the summary's and standard output's statements of it
one final answer per task: the session file's result block and standard output's result (no step id is reported on standard output)
one final accounting per task: the summary's per-model usage, standard output's per-model usage under errorCode and the completion's named USD total

limits: standard output's steps carry no id: they are retained and never joined with the session file's steps
a usage entry's cost names no unit and is never money; only completion.taskCostUsd is USD
no exit code is reported; the summary's lifecycle is the session's reported state
